submission.title: The exact 442-step verification threshold for 66 sixteen-position hash chains
submission.claim: Budget.cutoff proves that a deterministic incomparable encoding of all 2^256 digests into 66 chains with 16 positions exists with worst-case verification budget b exactly when 442 ≤ b. Each coordinate is the number of forward steps remaining. Complementing all digits recovers the usual signing positions and preserves incomparability. The lower bound covers encoders mixing ranks. At budget 442 an encoder can use exactly 442 verification and 548 signing steps for every digest. The central rank uses 495 of each. Both encodings contain 66 chain elements, or 2,112 bytes at 32 bytes per element.
submission.novelty: The track gives an unrestricted middle-rank capacity and the minimum chain count. This proof gives the exact worst-case verification cutoff at that chain count. Budget.sharp_budget projects an arbitrary cost-capped message antichain along symmetric chains to one fixed rank without merging messages. Budget.exact_capacity converts the result to an executable integer test for any bounded equal-chain grid below its midpoint. Budget.cutoff instantiates it with a carry-free packed polynomial and kernel arithmetic. Independent convolution and inclusion-exclusion give capacities 112101650233209645042019189632703548151609162860367953232562543460027527343276 and 116447303614810365777943216526551517424194884344492365343285200720362736940186 at 441 and 442, respectively.

sources.title: Revisiting the Constant-sum Winternitz One-time Signature with Applications to SPHINCS+ and XMSS
sources.relationship: Constant-sum Winternitz and optimal signature length are established prior work. This paper also credits Bos and Chaum for constant-sum encoding.

sources.title: At the Top of the Hypercube – Better Size-Time Tradeoffs for Hash-Based Signatures
sources.relationship: Prior verification-cost bounds and constructions include randomized and non-injective settings. This formalization addresses the deterministic worst-case antichain subproblem.

provenance.discovery_basis: I compared the problem brief, published constant-sum and hypercube results, the public research branch and PR history. I claim authorship of this Lean formalization and parameter calculation. I do not claim priority for the chain decomposition, fixed-sum encoding, coefficient-packing technique or underlying combinatorial bound.

evidence.reproduce: Run pnp check research/submissions/verification-budget-antichains.json --lean with the project-pinned verifier. For an independent arithmetic check, start with a[0]=1 and convolve 66 times with sixteen ones. Compare entries 441 and 442 to 2^256.

attribution.contributions: Codex, working for Edgars under the repository owner account MuncleUscles, wrote the decomposition and its inverse, bounded-budget equivalence, exhaustive grid specification, carry-free coefficient proof and concrete cutoff. The signer is the existing project contributor wallet. No credited proof bundles are imported.

submission.limitations: The theorem counts forward chain steps. It omits encoder work, key generation, authentication paths and aggregation costs. Its existence witness enumerates a finite rank and is unsuitable as a production encoder. Each verification step saved relative to the middle rank adds a signing step. Randomized encoders, collisions, expected cost, unequal chains, unforgeability against quantum adversaries and end-to-end performance require separate analysis.

-- Digits count remaining hash steps. The product order is coordinatewise.
def Grid (m k : Nat) (x : List Nat) : Prop :=
  x.length = k ∧ ∀ d ∈ x, d ≤ m

def Below : List Nat → List Nat → Prop
  | [], [] => True
  | a :: x, b :: y => a ≤ b ∧ Below x y
  | _, _ => False

def span (m : Nat) : List Nat → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | j :: js => span m js + m - 2*j

def Good (m : Nat) : List Nat → Prop
  | [] => True
  | j :: js => Good m js ∧ j ≤ span m js ∧ j ≤ m

-- Sweep each rectangle along its bottom edge, then up its right edge.
def point (m : Nat) : List Nat → Nat → List Nat
  | [], _ => []
  | j :: js, t =>
    let corner := span m js - j
    (j + (t - corner)) :: point m js (min t corner)

def locate (m : Nat) : List Nat → List Nat × Nat
  | [] => ([], 0)
  | d :: xs =>
    let (js, p) := locate m xs
    let j := min (span m js - p) d
    (j :: js, p + d - j)

theorem symmetry (m : Nat) (js : List Nat) (hg : Good m js) :
    2*js.sum + span m js = m*js.length := by
  induction js with
  | nil => simp [span]
  | cons j js ih =>
    obtain ⟨g, h, h'⟩ := hg
    have := ih g
    simp only [List.sum_cons, List.length_cons, Nat.mul_succ, span]
    omega

theorem monotone_point (m : Nat) (js : List Nat) (u v : Nat) (h : u ≤ v) :
    Below (point m js u) (point m js v) := by
  induction js generalizing u v with
  | nil => trivial
  | cons j js ih =>
    change _ ≤ _ ∧ _
    exact ⟨by omega, ih _ _ (by omega)⟩

theorem grid_point (m : Nat) (js : List Nat) (t : Nat)
    (hg : Good m js) (ht : t ≤ span m js) :
    Grid m js.length (point m js t) ∧
    (point m js t).sum = js.sum + t ∧
    locate m (point m js t) = (js, t) := by
  induction js generalizing t with
  | nil =>
    have h : t = 0 := by simpa [span] using ht
    subst t
    simp [Grid, point, locate]
  | cons j js ih =>
    obtain ⟨g, hj, hm⟩ := hg
    let s := span m js
    let p := min t (s-j)
    let d := j + (t-(s-j))
    change t ≤ s+m-2*j at ht
    change j ≤ s at hj
    have hp : p ≤ s := by dsimp [p]; omega
    have hd : d ≤ m := by dsimp [d]; omega
    obtain ⟨⟨hl, hb⟩, hr, hi⟩ := ih p g hp
    change Grid m (js.length+1) (d :: point m js p) ∧
      (d :: point m js p).sum = (j::js).sum + t ∧
      locate m (d :: point m js p) = (j :: js,t)
    constructor
    · exact ⟨by simp [hl], by simpa only [List.mem_cons, forall_eq_or_imp] using And.intro hd hb⟩
    constructor
    · simp only [List.sum_cons, hr]
      dsimp [d,p]
      omega
    · simp only [locate, hi]
      have hj' : min (span m js-p) d = j := by change min (s-p) d = j; dsimp [d,p]; omega
      rw [hj']
      have ht' : p+d-j=t := by dsimp [p,d]; omega
      rw [ht']

theorem locate_spec (m : Nat) (x : List Nat) (bounded : ∀ d ∈ x, d ≤ m) :
    let (js,t) := locate m x
    Good m js ∧ t ≤ span m js ∧ js.length = x.length ∧
      x.sum = js.sum + t ∧ point m js t = x := by
  induction x with
  | nil => simp [locate, Good, span, point]
  | cons d x ih =>
    obtain ⟨js,p, he⟩ : ∃ js p, locate m x = (js,p) := ⟨_, _, rfl⟩
    have hd : d ≤ m := bounded _ (by simp)
    have tail := ih (fun a ha => bounded a (by simp [ha]))
    rw [he] at tail
    obtain ⟨g, hp, hl, hr, hi⟩ := tail
    simp only [locate, he]
    let s := span m js
    let j := min (s-p) d
    let t := p+d-j
    change Good m (j::js) ∧ t ≤ span m (j::js) ∧ (j::js).length = (d::x).length ∧
      (d::x).sum = (j::js).sum + t ∧ point m (j::js) t = d::x
    change p ≤ s at hp
    have hj : j ≤ s := by dsimp [j]; omega
    have hjd : j ≤ d := by dsimp [j]; omega
    have h1 : j+(t-(s-j))=d := by dsimp [t,j]; omega
    have h2 : min t (s-j)=p := by dsimp [t,j]; omega
    refine ⟨⟨g,hj,by omega⟩, ?_, by simp [hl], ?_, ?_⟩
    · change t ≤ s + m - 2*j
      dsimp [t,j]
      omega
    · simp only [List.sum_cons, hr]
      dsimp [t]
      omega
    · change (j+(t-(s-j))) :: point m js (min t (s-j)) = d :: x
      rw [h1,h2,hi]

theorem equal_rank (x y : List Nat) (hle : Below x y) (hs : x.sum = y.sum) : x = y := by
  induction x generalizing y with
  | nil => cases y <;> simp_all [Below]
  | cons a x ih =>
    cases y with
    | nil => contradiction
    | cons b y =>
      obtain ⟨hab,hxy⟩ := hle
      have sum_mono : ∀ u v : List Nat, Below u v → u.sum ≤ v.sum := by
        intro u
        induction u with
        | nil => intro v _; exact Nat.zero_le _
        | cons c u hu =>
          intro v h
          cases v with
          | nil => contradiction
          | cons e v =>
            obtain ⟨hce,h'⟩ := h
            simpa only [List.sum_cons] using Nat.add_le_add hce (hu v h')
      have := sum_mono x y hxy
      simp only [List.sum_cons] at hs
      have hab' : a = b := by omega
      have hxy' := ih y hxy (by omega)
      rw [hab', hxy']

-- Every injective antichain encoder with a worst-case budget b can be
-- replaced by an injective encoder spending exactly b on every message.
-- Conversely the single rank already is an antichain.
def Encoder (M : Type) (m k b : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ e : M → List Nat, (∀ a, Grid m k (e a) ∧ (e a).sum ≤ b) ∧
    ∀ a c, Below (e a) (e c) → a = c

def Shell (M : Type) (m k b : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ f : M → List Nat, (∀ a, Grid m k (f a) ∧ (f a).sum = b) ∧
    ∀ a c, f a = f c → a = c

theorem sharp_budget (M : Type) (m k b : Nat) (half : 2*b ≤ m*k) :
    Encoder M m k b ↔ Shell M m k b := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨e,he,ha⟩
    let tag := fun a => (locate m (e a)).1
    let offset := fun a => (locate m (e a)).2
    have spec (a : M) : Good m (tag a) ∧ offset a ≤ span m (tag a) ∧
        (tag a).length = k ∧ (e a).sum = (tag a).sum + offset a ∧
        point m (tag a) (offset a) = e a := by
      have h := locate_spec m (e a) (he a).1.2
      cases hloc : locate m (e a) with
      | mk js t =>
        simp only [hloc] at h
        simpa only [tag, offset, hloc, (he a).1.1] using h
    let f := fun a => point m (tag a) (b - (tag a).sum)
    have lifted (a : M) : Grid m k (f a) ∧ (f a).sum = b ∧ (locate m (f a)).1 = tag a := by
      obtain ⟨hg,_,hk,hr,_⟩ := spec a
      have hcost := (he a).2
      have hsym := symmetry m (tag a) hg
      rw [hk] at hsym
      have room : b - (tag a).sum ≤ span m (tag a) := by omega
      obtain ⟨gg,rr,ll⟩ := grid_point m (tag a) _ hg room
      rw [hk] at gg
      exact ⟨gg, by dsimp [f]; omega, by dsimp only [f]; rw [ll]⟩
    refine ⟨f, fun a => ⟨(lifted a).1, (lifted a).2.1⟩, ?_⟩
    intro a c h
    have same : tag a = tag c := by rw [← (lifted a).2.2, h, (lifted c).2.2]
    have xa := (spec a).2.2.2.2
    have xc := (spec c).2.2.2.2
    rw [← same] at xc
    by_cases hle : offset a ≤ offset c
    · apply ha a c
      rw [← xa, ← xc]
      exact monotone_point _ _ _ _ hle
    · apply Eq.symm
      apply ha c a
      rw [← xc, ← xa]
      exact monotone_point _ _ _ _ (by omega)
  · rintro ⟨f,hf,hi⟩
    exact ⟨f, fun a => ⟨(hf a).1, Nat.le_of_eq (hf a).2⟩,
      fun a c h => hi a c (equal_rank _ _ h ((hf a).2.trans (hf c).2.symm))⟩


-- Enumerate each grid word once. This specification is never evaluated at
-- the challenge parameters: packed coefficients certify its rank counts.
def words (m : Nat) : Nat → List (List Nat)
  | 0 => [[]]
  | k+1 => (List.range (m+1)).flatMap (fun d => (words m k).map (d :: ·))

theorem mem_words (m k : Nat) (x : List Nat) : x ∈ words m k ↔ Grid m k x := by
  induction k generalizing x with
  | zero => cases x <;> simp [words, Grid]
  | succ k ih =>
    cases x with
    | nil => simp [words, Grid]
    | cons d x =>
      simp [words, Grid, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_map, ih, List.cons.injEq,
        Nat.lt_succ_iff, and_assoc, and_comm, and_left_comm]

theorem words_unique (m k : Nat) : (words m k).Nodup := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [words]
  | succ k ih =>
    apply List.pairwise_flatMap.mpr
    constructor
    · intro d _
      exact List.pairwise_map.mpr (ih.imp (by intro a b h e; exact h (List.cons.inj e).2))
    · apply List.nodup_range.imp
      intro a b hab x hx y hy hxy
      obtain ⟨u,_,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
      obtain ⟨v,_,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hy
      exact hab (List.cons.inj hxy).1

def layer (m k b : Nat) := (words m k).filter (fun x => x.sum == b)

theorem layer_mem (m k b : Nat) (x : List Nat) :
    x ∈ layer m k b ↔ Grid m k x ∧ x.sum = b := by simp [layer, mem_words]

theorem cover_bound (u v : List (List Nat)) (hu : u.Nodup) (h : ∀ x ∈ u, x ∈ v) :
    u.length ≤ v.length := by
  induction u generalizing v with
  | nil => exact Nat.zero_le _
  | cons a u ih =>
    obtain ⟨ha,hn⟩ := List.nodup_cons.mp hu
    have hav := h a (by simp)
    have hp := List.length_pos_of_mem hav
    have hh : ∀ x ∈ u, x ∈ v.erase a := by
      intro x hx
      apply (List.mem_erase_of_ne (by intro e; exact ha (e ▸ hx) : x ≠ a)).mpr
      exact h _ (by simp [hx])
    have z := ih _ hn hh
    rw [List.length_erase_of_mem hav] at z
    simp only [List.length_cons]
    omega

theorem shell_size (N m k b : Nat) : Shell (Fin N) m k b ↔ N ≤ (layer m k b).length := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, hf, hi⟩
    have hn : (List.ofFn f).Nodup := by
      apply List.pairwise_iff_getElem.mpr
      intro i j hi' hj' hij he
      simp only [List.getElem_ofFn] at he
      have hval : i = j := congrArg Fin.val (hi _ _ he)
      omega
    have hc : ∀ x ∈ List.ofFn f, x ∈ layer m k b := by
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨i,rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.mp hx
      exact (layer_mem _ _ _ _).mpr (hf i)
    simpa using cover_bound _ _ hn hc
  · intro h
    let l := layer m k b
    let f := fun i : Fin N => l[i.val]'(Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le i.isLt h)
    refine ⟨f, fun i => (layer_mem _ _ _ _).mp (List.getElem_mem _), ?_⟩
    intro i j he
    have hn : l.Nodup := List.Pairwise.filter _ (words_unique m k)
    have hp := List.pairwise_iff_getElem.mp hn
    apply Fin.ext
    by_cases hij : i.val < j.val
    · exact False.elim ((hp i.val j.val _ _ hij) he)
    by_cases hji : j.val < i.val
    · exact False.elim ((hp j.val i.val _ _ hji) he.symm)
    omega

-- A weighted sum over all words factors as a product of digit sums.
def total {A : Type} (f : A → Nat) : List A → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | x :: xs => f x + total f xs

theorem total_append {A : Type} (f : A → Nat) (u v : List A) :
    total f (u++v) = total f u + total f v := by
  induction u with
  | nil => simp [total]
  | cons a u ih => simp only [List.cons_append,total,ih,Nat.add_assoc]

theorem total_flat {A D : Type} (f : A → Nat) (g : D → List A) (u : List D) :
    total f (u.flatMap g) = total (fun d => total f (g d)) u := by
  induction u with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a u ih => simp [total, total_append, ih]

theorem total_map {A D : Type} (f : D → Nat) (g : A → D) (u : List A) :
    total f (u.map g) = total (fun d => f (g d)) u := by
  induction u <;> simp [total, *]

theorem total_scale {A : Type} (f : A → Nat) (c : Nat) (u : List A) :
    total (fun x => f x * c) u = total f u * c := by
  induction u <;> simp [total,Nat.add_mul, *]

theorem grid_factor (m k : Nat) (f : List Nat → Nat) (g : Nat → Nat)
    (empty : f [] = 1) (step : ∀ d x, f (d::x) = f x * g d) :
    total f (words m k) = (total g (List.range (m+1)))^k := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [words,total,empty]
  | succ k ih =>
    simp only [words,total_flat,total_map,step,total_scale,ih,Nat.pow_succ]
    rw [Nat.mul_comm]
    let v := total g (List.range (m+1)) ^ k
    rw [show (fun d => v * g d) = (fun d => g d * v) from funext (fun _ => Nat.mul_comm _ _)]
    rw [total_scale]

theorem total_one {A : Type} (u : List A) : total (fun _ => 1) u = u.length := by
  induction u <;> simp [total, *,Nat.add_comm]

-- A base larger than the whole grid prevents carries between rank counts.
def dropZero : List Nat → List Nat
  | [] => []
  | 0 :: xs => dropZero xs
  | (n+1) :: xs => n :: dropZero xs

theorem drop_len (u : List Nat) : (dropZero u).length ≤ u.length := by
  induction u with
  | nil => simp [dropZero]
  | cons n u ih => cases n <;> simp [dropZero] <;> omega

theorem drop_count (u : List Nat) (s : Nat) : (dropZero u).count s = u.count (s+1) := by
  induction u with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons n u ih => cases n <;> simp [dropZero,List.count_cons,ih]

theorem split_digit (q : Nat) (u : List Nat) :
    total (fun t => q^t) u = u.count 0 + q * total (fun t => q^t) (dropZero u) := by
  induction u with
  | nil => simp [total,dropZero]
  | cons n u ih =>
    cases n <;> simp [total,dropZero,List.count_cons,ih,Nat.pow_succ',Nat.mul_add] <;> omega

theorem digit_count (q s : Nat) (u : List Nat) (room : u.length < q) :
    (total (fun t => q^t) u / q^s) % q = u.count s := by
  induction s generalizing u with
  | zero =>
    rw [Nat.pow_zero,Nat.div_one,split_digit,Nat.add_mul_mod_self_left,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt]
    exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt List.count_le_length room
  | succ s ih =>
    rw [Nat.pow_succ',←Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul,split_digit,Nat.add_mul_div_left _ _ (by omega),
       Nat.div_eq_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt List.count_le_length room),Nat.zero_add,
       ih _ (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (drop_len _) room),drop_count]

theorem filter_count (u : List (List Nat)) (b : Nat) :
    (u.filter (fun x => x.sum == b)).length = (u.map List.sum).count b := by
  induction u with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x u ih => by_cases h : x.sum = b <;> simp [h, List.count_cons, ih]

def packed (q m k b : Nat) :=
  ((total (fun d => q^d) (List.range (m+1)))^k / q^b) % q

theorem exact_capacity (N m k b q : Nat) (h : 2*b ≤ m*k) (room : (m+1)^k < q) :
    Encoder (Fin N) m k b ↔ N ≤ packed q m k b := by
  rw [sharp_budget _ _ _ _ h, shell_size]
  have card := grid_factor m k (fun _ => 1) (fun _ => 1) rfl (by simp)
  simp only [total_one,List.length_range] at card
  have hroom : ((words m k).map List.sum).length < q := by simpa [card] using room
  have hd := digit_count q b _ hroom
  rw [total_map] at hd
  have mass := grid_factor m k (fun x => q^x.sum) (fun d => q^d) (by simp)
    (by intro d x; simp [Nat.pow_add, Nat.mul_comm])
  change ((total (fun x : List Nat => q^x.sum) (words m k)) / q^b) % q = _ at hd
  rw [mass] at hd
  simpa only [layer, filter_count, packed, hd]

-- The base is 2^265, one bit wider than the entire 16^66 grid.
-- Writing its two factors separately keeps the literal exponents small.
def radix : Nat := 2^133 * 2^132

theorem cutoff (b : Nat) : Encoder (Fin (2^256)) 15 66 b ↔ 442 ≤ b := by
  have room : 16^66 < radix := by decide
  have small : ¬ Encoder (Fin (2^256)) 15 66 441 := by
    rw [exact_capacity _ _ _ _ radix (by decide) room]
    decide
  have enough : Encoder (Fin (2^256)) 15 66 442 := by
    rw [exact_capacity _ _ _ _ radix (by decide) room]
    decide
  have mono (u v : Nat) (hv : u ≤ v) : Encoder (Fin (2^256)) 15 66 u →
      Encoder (Fin (2^256)) 15 66 v := by
    rintro ⟨e,h,ha⟩
    exact ⟨e, fun a => ⟨(h a).1, Nat.le_trans (h a).2 hv⟩, ha⟩
  constructor
  · intro hb
    by_cases h : 442 ≤ b
    · exact h
    · exact False.elim (small (mono b 441 (by omega) hb))
  · exact fun hb => mono 442 b hb enough

end Budget
